question: Which of the following is the first Indian woman Grandmaster in Chess?
solution:
The correct answer is __**S Vijayalakshmi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **S Vijayalakshmi** became India's first woman Grandmaster in Chess.
 
• She achieved this title in the year **2001**.
 
• Vijayalakshmi has been a pioneering figure in Indian women's chess and has set a benchmark for future generations.
 
• She has also won several national and international titles, contributing significantly to Indian chess.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grandmaster (GM)**

 
 
• It is the highest title awarded by FIDE, the international chess federation.
 
• Apart from World Champion, Grandmaster is the highest title a chess player can attain.
 
• Once achieved, the title is held for life, though exceptionally it can be revoked for cheating.
 
 
 
• **FIDE**
 
 
• FIDE stands for Fédération Internationale des Échecs or International Chess Federation.
 
• It is the organization that governs international chess competition.
 
• FIDE was founded in Paris, France, on July 20, 1924.
 
 
 
• **International Titles in Chess**
 
 
• FIDE awards several titles to chess players: Grandmaster (GM), International Master (IM), FIDE Master (FM), and Candidate Master (CM).
 
• For women, there are equivalent titles: Woman Grandmaster (WGM), Woman International Master (WIM), Woman FIDE Master (WFM), and Woman Candidate Master (WCM).
 
 
 
• **Key Women Chess Players in India**
 
 
• **Koneru Humpy**: She is the second Indian woman to achieve the GM title and has been one of the top female players globally.
 
• **Harika Dronavalli**: Another prominent Indian woman Grandmaster who has won multiple medals in international competitions.
 
• **Tania Sachdev**: Known for her achievements in chess as well as her role as a chess commentator and presenter.
 
• **R Vaishali**: A young and promising talent in Indian chess, she is also the sister of GM Praggnanandhaa.
